title: Descobrir v1 CoverageReport
description: Machine-readable coverage and gate report for one Descobrir load (baseline candidate). Captures schema validation, Provenance Coverage (artifact_reference_percentage + repository_verified_percentage), unresolved IDs, status histogram, repeatability via canonical_graph_hash, freshness, producer_baseline (with result pass|fail), mutation pre/post equivalence, threshold (required booleans), and overall passed. passed is the implementation invariant: schema_result.valid AND threshold.require_schema_valid implication, repeatability.result==pass when require_repeatability_pass, mutation.equivalent when require_mutation_equivalent, producer_baseline.result==pass when require_producer_reconciliation_pass, AND provenance.repository_verified_percentage >= threshold.minimum_repository_verified_percentage. Timestamps are metadata only and MUST NOT participate in canonical_graph_hash. Graph-to-previous-baseline deltas are out of scope for this report v1. Must not embed secrets, env values, connection strings, raw code payloads, absolute paths, or dirty-file contents.

id.description: Identifier of this coverage report document.

namespace.description: Knowledge Namespace of the owning project.

source_revision.description: Pinned logical VCS revision that anchors the reported load.

artifact_manifest_id.description: Content-addressed Artifact Manifest id for the load under report (see artifact-manifest.schema.json id semantics).

graph_index_id.description: Graph Index ID whose canonical_graph_hash and ID lists this report evaluates.

valid.description: True when all emitted records, relations, manifest, and graph index satisfy their Descobrir v1 schemas.

path.description: JSON Pointer or logical path to the failing location.

schema_id.description: Optional schema $id that rejected the instance.

total_entities.description: Total Knowledge Records + Relations in the load (denominator for both rates).

artifact_reference_count.description: Entities (records + relations) with a valid Artifact Reference: manifest_id present, artifact_path resolvable in the manifest, content_sha256 matching, range well-formed.

artifact_reference_percentage.description: Provenance Coverage rate 1: 100 * artifact_reference_count / total_entities, or 0 when total_entities is 0. Valid artifact provenance only.

repository_verified_count.description: Entities (records + relations) with Repository Reference verified against pinned source_revision AND status comprovado. Each entity must carry its own verified repository evidence.

repository_verified_percentage.description: Provenance Coverage rate 2: 100 * repository_verified_count / total_entities, or 0 when total_entities is 0. Artifact-only entities stay hipótese and do not count here.

artifact_only_count.description: Optional count of entities whose evidence is artifact-only (cannot be comprovado).

provenance.description: Provenance Coverage metric set (single definition): artifact_reference_percentage + repository_verified_percentage. Sampling audits do not promote entities to comprovado.

unresolved_ids.description: Canonical IDs (records and/or relations) with unresolvable repository references or missing natural-key material.

contradição.description: Count of entities with status contradição (status enum value, never a separate flag).

stale.description: Count of entities with status stale. v1 may be zero; stale is for later freshness consumers.

status_counts.description: Histogram of status values across Knowledge Records and Relations for the load.

result.description: pass when two Adapter index runs on identical Native Artifact bytes + source_revision produce the same canonical_graph_hash.

canonical_graph_hash.description: canonical_graph_hash under comparison (MUST equal GraphIndex.canonical_graph_hash for the run). Covers canonicalized complete structured Records/Relations including evidence and status; excludes narrative/observational metadata. Manifest id and raw artifact hashes are not substitutes.

baseline_hash.description: Optional second-run canonical_graph_hash used only for same-input repeatability comparison (not a previous published graph baseline).

details.description: Optional human-readable explanation of structural divergence. Must not be required for machine gating. Must not embed secrets or raw payloads.

repeatability.description: Repeatability of the Artifact Adapter index for identical Native Artifact bytes + source_revision. Compares canonical_graph_hash. Re-running the Discovery Engine is not part of this v1 gate.

source_revision.description: Revision at which facts were observed. v1 records source_revision; no incremental updater in this flow.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 observation timestamp. Metadata only; excluded from canonical_graph_hash.

stale_record_ids.description: Record/relation IDs already marked stale relative to a newer known head, when available. Consumed by later freshness checks.

producer_baseline.description: Compares arbitrary producer-declared metrics against arbitrary indexed metrics from this load. Not a previous graph baseline. Graph-to-previous-baseline deltas are out of scope for coverage-report v1.

declared_counts.description: Producer-declared metric counts keyed by metric name. Values are non-negative integers. Metric names are profile-defined generic strings.

indexed_counts.description: Indexed metric counts for the same metric name space after adaptation. Values are non-negative integers.

deltas.description: Per-metric comparison rows. Every delta object requires a non-empty explanation. delta is indexed - declared and MAY be negative when the index under-counts the producer declaration.

result.description: pass when every delta has a non-empty explanation and producer reconciliation policy for the load is satisfied; fail otherwise. Feeds threshold.require_producer_reconciliation_pass and overall passed.

pre.description: Target repository / workspace snapshot before the load.

post.description: Target repository / workspace snapshot after the load.

equivalent.description: True when pre and post are equivalent for all surfaces the load must not mutate (target repo tracked tree outside harness output). Required true for passed when threshold.require_mutation_equivalent is true.

mutation.description: Pre/post equivalence evidence that the load did not mutate the target repository. Dirty path names/counts only — never dirty-file contents.

require_schema_valid.description: When true, schema_result.valid must be true for passed.

require_repeatability_pass.description: When true, repeatability.result must be pass for passed.

require_mutation_equivalent.description: When true, mutation.equivalent must be true for passed.

require_producer_reconciliation_pass.description: When true, producer_baseline.result must be pass for passed.

threshold.description: Gate threshold. All five fields are required. passed is the implementation invariant combining these booleans with repository_verified_percentage.

passed.description: Implementation invariant (not an independent free boolean). MUST equal the conjunction of: (NOT threshold.require_schema_valid OR schema_result.valid) AND (NOT threshold.require_repeatability_pass OR repeatability.result == pass) AND (NOT threshold.require_mutation_equivalent OR mutation.equivalent) AND (NOT threshold.require_producer_reconciliation_pass OR producer_baseline.result == pass) AND (provenance.repository_verified_percentage >= threshold.minimum_repository_verified_percentage). Producer deltas without non-empty explanation force producer_baseline.result=fail and thus can force passed=false.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 report generation timestamp. Metadata only; MUST NOT enter canonical_graph_hash.

producer_run_id.description: Optional run correlation id. Metadata only.

metadata.description: Observational metadata excluded from canonical_graph_hash semantics. Must not embed secrets or raw payloads.

metricCountMap.description: Map of metric name → non-negative integer count. Keys are non-empty strings; no fixed metric vocabulary in this generic contract.

metric.description: Metric name matching a key in declared_counts and/or indexed_counts.

indexed.description: Indexed count for this metric after adaptation.

delta.description: indexed - declared. Negative when the index under-counts the producer declaration; positive when it over-counts.

explanation.description: Required non-empty machine-oriented note on why the delta exists (including when delta is 0 — e.g. "exact match").

summary_hash.description: Hash of the canonical mutation-relevant snapshot (tracked paths, object counts, dirty-path names without content values). Never includes dirty-file contents, secrets, or absolute machine paths as identity.

dirty_path_count.description: Count of dirty paths observed; values of dirty contents MUST NOT be copied into the report.

anchor_object_present.description: Whether the pinned source_revision object was resolvable at snapshot time.
